removalTriggers: a patched braces 3.x release becomes available to the Tailwind 3 dependency graph
the project completes its Tailwind 4 migration

residuals.rationale: The advisory is currently reachable only through Tailwind 3 build tooling. Production npm audit must remain clean; the exception is invalid if any affected package is production-reachable.
